journal: The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition
effectSize: SEE roughly 150–180 kcal/day depending on sex subgroup
limitations: Not validated as a weight-loss intervention endpoint
title: A new predictive equation for resting energy expenditure in healthy individuals

keyFinding.enGB: Resting energy expenditure is predicted from weight, height, age and sex with less bias than earlier Harris–Benedict equations in this healthy sample.
keyFinding.uk: Витрати енергії у спокої передбачаються за вагою, зростом, віком і статтю з меншою похибкою, ніж у рівняннях Гарріса–Бенедикта, у цій вибірці здорових дорослих.

evidenceGrade.rationale: Large healthy cohort with direct calorimetry reference; single-centre and not a trial of dietary outcomes.
